column1: # Fixtures in the ordinary assets/ _ok folders that the pinned Mojo rejects.
# AGENTS.md invariant 1 says this file should be empty; it is the burn-down
# list, and scripts/sweep-assets-mojo fails when reality and this file differ.
# other family this file once carried is closed: a fixture that had an
# upstream spelling was respelled, and one whose *shape* the pin refuses —
# origin-parameter erasure, cross-origin field stores, parametric-mut pointer
# writes, partial field moves, capturing-lambda locals, mut-self callable
# structs, owned-interior generations, the Mojito-only stdlib modules — moved
# to assets/extensions/, where `--extensions` asserts the rejection instead.
# The error is the pin's FIRST complaint, so it can mask a later one: lifting
# a mask moves a row to another family rather than deleting it.
